## Episode conclusion (advisory, not acceptance)

Intent: DELIVER
Statement: The rejection is now explained by a measured boundary, not by another wording or ordering guess. A Git hook spawned by the agent's Bash tool inherits the workspace sandbox: a probe hook could write inside /run/stage/world but writing /run/stage/state/.sandbox-hook-canary failed with Permission denied. The project journal lives at /run/stage/state/journal.sqlite, so the direct-delivery hook could install, run and decide correctly but could not append the record. Independently, the candidate bundle carries only HEAD; when the prepared review is exposed as a tag or bare commit, the old branch-tip test refused to name the new review path.

Fix in ebbafa1 and 8b298c0: (1) the guard starts a bounded in-process observer (250 ms, 10-minute window, extended by each pulse) when a deployment is live. It watches HEAD in the product process outside the Bash sandbox and calls the same runDirectDeliveryGuard. (2) Prepared advances are recognized from HEAD's reflog (merge/pull), with the branch-tip check retained as a fallback. (3) The observer stops when its config disappears, and stopDirectDeliveryGuardWatcher() gives no-guard callers an explicit control. All paths still refresh only a current existing DELIVER conclusion; they create no judgement, accept nothing, promote nothing and advance no canonical head, and still refuse ordinary commits, dirty trees, moved bytes, resolved/reopened conclusions and reopening journal facts.

Verification: scripts/pnwf/software/self-maintenance-prepared-ref.mjs passes 72/72 over the sealed case-1/case-2 owners and receipt commits for both arms, with branch, tag, bare-commit and hook-removed scenarios plus ordinary-commit controls. On pre-fix 2ba8c7f it exits 1 with 24 false checks; a reflog-only build fails only the four watcher checks, isolating both causes. All nine maintenance oracles pass; test/pnwf_direct_guard.test.ts 6/6 and alhs_episode_convergence 13/13. Two unrelated deployment tests still fail only because this isolated checkout lacks e2e/project-workspace.spec.ts and examples/deployment. Limit: the observer runs only while a deployment is live; a commit made with no product process still relies on the hook or on the next pulse's required action.
